body:
## Why

`select_candidate`'s reply says "lodging" twice when it selects a stay's lodging. Seen in #62's local checks:

> Selected Skyview Hotel as the lodging for the lodging of Stay 2, Torrey (stay_8qjff67e).

The coordinator reads this reply. It still understood it, but text an agent reads should be clean, so an odd reply is never a reason for odd behavior in a trace.

## Design

- [Tool design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/tools.md), section 2.1, `select_candidate`.

## Open questions

None.

## Do

- Fix the lodging line in `selectedLine()` in `src/tools/selection-tools.ts`. It puts "as the lodging for" in front of `holderName()`, which already starts "the lodging of". The reply should read once, such as "Selected Skyview Hotel as the lodging of Stay 2, Torrey (stay_…)."
- Rewrite the coordinator's view file if the change shows in it.

## Done when

- A test of `select_candidate` on a stay's lodging gives the reply with "lodging" once.
- `npm run check` passes.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** the PR.
